{{Quote|Hello! I am Minister of Arts for the Narmle government. In this crucially important position, at this crucially important time of our Narmle Arts Gala, I have commissioned a holo presentation from a rising artist. It will certainly show up that imitative Restuss Arts Jubilee for the tone-deaf debacle it customarily is. Will you pick it up and bring it here?|Oxil Sarban to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:OS" />}}
'''Oxil Sarban''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was the [[Minister of Arts]] for the Narmle government and gave some assignments to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Oxil Sarban was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:OS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
